summary: Recursively traverses a tree of nodes. Skips the whole traversal when bit 1 of the byte at this+0x3C is set. Otherwise recurses into the child pointer at this+0x44 when non-null, then recurses into the pointer at this+0x4C only when both this+0x40 and this+0x4C are non-null, and finally processes the current node via sub_561660, returning its result. Called from sub_5613E0.

local_names.a1: this node whose children and self are visited
local_names.result: uninitialized early-return value when the skip flag is set (Hex-Rays artifact)

operations.description: Test bit 1 (value 2) of the byte at this+0x3C; when it is set, skip the entire traversal and return without visiting children or the node itself.
Read the child pointer at this+0x44 and recurse only when it is non-null.
Recursively traverse the child node at this+0x44.
Read the pointer at this+0x40 and gate the second recursion on it being non-null.
Read the pointer at this+0x4C and recurse into it only when both this+0x40 and this+0x4C are non-null.
Recursively traverse the node at this+0x4C when the double guard passes.
Process the current node via sub_561660 and return its result.
Return the result of sub_561660 as the traversal outcome for the current node.
